properties.report:
Travelers can expect the following: ENFORCED ROAD CLOSURE with delays 5 minutes, 6 mile detour, local traffic, and 6 mile truck detour until further notice.
Hwy 11 closed between 257th St and 258th St for bridge and roadway reconstruction. Detour route designated for all traffic. Roadway only open to local traffic.
